title: Urban Pedestrian Scenarios for AV Safety
description: CityDrive Labs is preparing a safety benchmark for Level-4 autonomous shuttles and needs short video clips capturing pedestrians interacting with crosswalks, construction zones, and curbside drop-offs across multiple cities. Contributors should document both day and night conditions and annotate any unusual behaviors (e-scooters, jaywalking, mobility aids).
quality_criteria: Minimum 1080p resolution
Include ambient audio from the street
Capture both peak and off-peak traffic
requirements: Clips must be recorded in public streets with visible safety signage
admin_notes: Reviewed safety compliance deck and anonymization approach.

title: Multilingual Airline Support Emails
description: SkyBridge Airways is training a generative assistant to triage flight disruption emails in English, Spanish, French, and German. They need real examples of customer emails paired with anonymized airline responses, covering delays, baggage, schedule changes, and loyalty inquiries.
quality_criteria: Each email thread must include at least one customer and one agent message
Personal data must be redacted using provided macros
Tag language and issue category in the metadata template
requirements: Accepts .eml or .txt exports from ticketing tools
admin_notes: GDPR compliance memo signed off by legal.

title: Pediatric Respiratory Auscultation Sounds
description: Children's Health Research UK is collecting high-quality stethoscope recordings to improve early detection of pediatric asthma and bronchiolitis. Contributors will upload de-identified lung sound clips captured with electronic stethoscopes, accompanied by basic clinical context fields.
quality_criteria: Use provided auscultation protocol (anterior/posterior, four points)
Noise floor below -50 dB
Clip length between 15-30 seconds
requirements: Only contributors with pediatric care certification
Upload anonymized patient age range and symptoms
admin_notes: IRB exemption verified; store in encrypted bucket.

title: Industrial Robot Downtime Logs
description: Rivet Automation is aggregating downtime events from robotic welding cells to refine predictive maintenance models. Each submission should include PLC logs, maintenance annotations, and sensor snapshots for the affected shift.
quality_criteria: Logs must cover at least 6 continuous hours
Include root-cause label agreed by maintenance lead
Provide synchronized sensor exports (vibration, temperature)
requirements: Upload PLC logs in CSV or JSON
Attach photo of affected station when possible
Sign confidentiality agreement before first upload
admin_notes: Finance approved $25k flat contract; milestone invoicing.

title: Rare Plant Leaf Imagery
description: The International Botanic Exchange is cataloging high-resolution photographs of rare and endangered plant species to aid conservation modeling. Contributors should capture top, underside, and macro views of leaves and provide GPS proximity metadata.
quality_criteria: Minimum 24MP RAW or high-quality JPEG
Include color calibration card in first frame
Add botanical name using provided taxonomy list
requirements: Must include GPS coordinates within 50m accuracy

title: Non-native English Accent Speech Corpus
description: LinguaNova AI is expanding its contact center speech recognizer with accents from Central and Eastern Europe, South Asia, and West Africa. Contributors record scripted and spontaneous speech following the provided prompt packs.
quality_criteria: 16 kHz, 16-bit PCM WAV format
No more than 2% background noise
Include accent self-identification in metadata
requirements: Upload both scripted and improvised recordings
admin_notes: QA spot-checking first 50 hours for calibration.

title: De-identified Hospital Admission Summaries
description: CareFlow Analytics is building a triage recommender and requires de-identified emergency department admission summaries with structured triage decisions. Data should span cardiac, trauma, respiratory, and gastrointestinal chief complaints.
quality_criteria: Narrative length between 120-250 words
Use provided SNOMED CT code mappings
Remove direct identifiers per HIPAA Safe Harbor
requirements: Upload triage acuity and disposition fields

title: Drone Wildlife Observation Videos
description: WildScan Initiative is curating annotated drone footage of large mammals in savanna ecosystems to improve detection models for anti-poaching patrols. Submissions should include bounding-box annotations for each herd member and environmental notes.
quality_criteria: 4K or stabilized 2.7K footage
Manual annotations must match provided schema
Log weather and time of day in metadata
requirements: Upload GPS flight path GPX file

title: Smart Home Energy Usage Streams
description: Enerlytics GmbH is aggregating multi-sensor time series from smart homes (electricity, HVAC, solar generation) to train demand-response forecasts. Contributors provide daily CSV exports and configuration metadata.
quality_criteria: Sampling interval <= 5 minutes
Include at least 30 consecutive days
Provide separate channels for generation vs. consumption
requirements: Anonymize address to postal code only
admin_notes: VAT invoice template sent to finance.

title: Rural Road Sign Photographs
description: Atlas Navigation is filling blind spots in its map data by sourcing imagery of rural road signage (warning, regulatory, informational) across North America and Australia. Each submission should include front and angled views under varied lighting.
quality_criteria: Minimum 12MP resolution
Tag retroreflective damage if present
Capture GPS coordinates and compass heading
requirements: Provide both day and dusk versions when possible
admin_notes: Custom signage taxonomy synced to UI.

title: Devanagari Handwritten Characters
description: ScriptLearn Labs is preparing a handwriting recognition benchmark focused on Devanagari characters and ligatures. Contributors submit scanned worksheet pages following tracing guides for balanced character coverage.
quality_criteria: Scan at 600 DPI grayscale
Ensure even lighting and no motion blur
Include contributor ID code in footer

title: Public Transit Crowd Audio Profiles
description: MetroSense is studying perceived crowding levels on rapid transit lines. Contributors capture ambient audio during peak and off-peak hours and label perceived comfort, line name, and rolling stock type.
quality_criteria: 44.1 kHz stereo or binaural recording
Record at least 90 seconds continuously
Tag perceived crowd level on 1-5 scale
requirements: Capture both station dwell and in-car segments
Note exact time and direction of travel
Avoid conversations that can identify individuals

title: AR Indoor Navigation Point Clouds
description: Wayfind XR is enhancing its indoor positioning engine and needs RGB-D point clouds of large public buildings (airports, malls, hospitals). Contributors will capture scans using supported LiDAR devices and upload aligned floorplan references.
quality_criteria: Point cloud density >= 300k points per scan
Align scans to building coordinates
Provide obstacle annotations (kiosks, signage)
requirements: Capture at least two floors per building
admin_notes: Enterprise SLA signed; project in premium tier.

title: Sign Language Gesture Clips
description: SignSpeak Foundation is expanding its ASL-to-text translation dataset with new contributors across age groups. Upload 5-15 second RGB video clips for each targeted sign, following the provided framing and lighting guidelines.
quality_criteria: 1080p at 60 fps preferred
Hands and face must remain fully in frame
Include sign label slate at start
requirements: Contributors must sign consent and release
No jewelry that obscures hand pose

title: Satellite Nighttime Urban Lighting
description: GeoLumens is benchmarking sustainable development indicators using nighttime satellite imagery. Contributors provide cloud-free composites for secondary cities worldwide along with human-verified land-use annotations.
quality_criteria: Radiance-calibrated GeoTIFF
Cloud cover under 5%
Include vector mask for water bodies
requirements: Attach write-up of image correction workflow
